archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with Industrial Professionalism

rules: No Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.
Headings must use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase, tiny, and wide spacing: tracking-[0.2em].
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.
Heading jump gap rule: Avoid jumping more than 2 Tailwind steps between H1 and subtitles.
typography.installation: Add Google Fonts links for Chivo and IBM Plex Sans in index.html or import in CSS.

rules: Tinted Grey Rule: Neutral greys are tinted with slate (blueish-grey) to feel alive.
Contrast ratio must strictly be APCA/WCAG compliant.
Hover states must be a lighter/darker hue of the active state. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.
DO NOT use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4).
Alerts for low stock MUST use the high-contrast #FF3333.

grids_and_layouts.philosophy: High Density Grid for Dashboards. Every pixel utilized for 500+ items.
grids_and_layouts.surface_strategy: The Technical Look. Expose the skeleton. Cardless, flat backgrounds with 1px border-slate-200. No heavy shadows by default. Use border-collapse style layouts for dense data.

components.tables: Core inventory table must be dense, utilizing full width, clear row-level actions, and sticky headers. Implement Shadcn Table.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), high contrast. Primary actions in Deep Emerald.
components.inputs: Shadcn Form/Input/Select components heavily customized. Flat, 1px border, focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500. NO transparency on dropdowns.
components.badges: For stock status. High contrast solid backgrounds (e.g., Red for low stock, Emerald for in-stock) with white text. No soft pastel badges.
components.dialogs: Shadcn Dialog for Add/Edit item and supplier info. Must have solid background and subtle 1px border.
components.toasts: Use 'sonner' for success/error alerts (e.g., Item added, Low stock warning).

visual_enhancers.surface_details: Flat Solid surfaces for data to prevent visual refraction. No Glassmorphism for the main dashboard to ensure maximum readability.
visual_enhancers.motion: Micro-interactions on rows: hover:bg-slate-50. Buttons: hover:-translate-y-[1px] hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-200.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Use text shadow over images if necessary.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-item-button', data-testid='inventory-table-row').

icons_and_assets.library: phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or regular weight for dense dashboards)

auth_background.description: Spacious empty warehouse interior with polished concrete floor to be used as a split-screen login page background to reinforce the physical/inventory aspect of the app.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust Dashboard layout with a fixed left sidebar (navigation) and top header (user profile/search).
For the inventory table, ensure advanced filtering (categories, stock level) and search are immediately accessible above the table.
Implement 'Low Stock Alerts' prominently, perhaps as a summary widget at the top (e.g., '12 Items Low on Stock').
Forms for 'Add/Edit Item' must handle SKU/Barcode fields seamlessly.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use left-aligned dense grids.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
Ensure the UI does not look like standard 'Vercel/Stripe' by adhering strictly to the Chivo/IBM Plex typography and flat, technical border styling.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements as strictly requested.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Push for the defined High-Contrast Technical look.
Never use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through 1px borders and layered z-index, not heavy shadows.
Never use AI assistant Emojis for icons.
Prioritize reusing existing components in src/components/ui.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided ones.
